name: Sungkyunkwan University
summary: Seoul and Suwon university dating from 1398; six English-track degrees take international freshmen in the fall without a Korean test.

handoff.label: International undergraduate admission notices and guides

ib.text: IB results are accepted as an academic reference with your transcript; no minimum IB score is published. English Track units ask for an English test (TOEFL, IELTS) unless you are from an English-speaking country.

apply.via: SKKU international admission site, documents by post

programmes.name: Human Science and Society
programmes.about: An English-track interdisciplinary major in the College of Social Sciences that pairs social science with AI, data analytics and language processing, then applies them in electives on governance, the economy, and education and communication.
programmes.ib: English-track unit: an English test is part of the application unless you are exempt as a national of an English-speaking country.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering
programmes.about: SKKU's chemical engineering school covers bio and environmental technology, materials and related areas on the Suwon campus. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you move into your chosen major in year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

programmes.name: Advanced Materials Science and Engineering
programmes.about: A materials engineering department on the Suwon campus, accredited by the Korean engineering accreditation board ABEEK since 2007. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you enter the major you applied to in year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: The School of Mechanical Engineering joins departments founded in 1966 and 1978 and teaches multidisciplinary mechanical engineering on the Suwon campus. Admitted through the Engineering English Track, you enter this major in year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

programmes.name: Nano Engineering
programmes.about: A department set up in 2018 around nano-fabrication and its fusion with other fields, teaching nanomaterials, nanodevices and nanoprocesses from theory at the nanoscale to practical use. It is based on the Suwon campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Core computer science with an emphasis on convergence, mandatory team projects from the third semester, an industry or lab internship requirement and a 10,000 Line Project on open-source software, on the Suwon campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents only, weighing grades, language proficiency and activities. 2027 Spring guide shown (English Track, Fall open); Fall 2027 guide not yet published.

notes: Fall 2027 dates are not out: the 2027 guide marks these six units open for the Fall semester, and the 2026 Fall guide appeared in January 2026.
Global Business Administration, Global Economics and Biomedical Engineering take English Track students for the Spring (March) 2027 semester only, not the Fall.
English Track students need no Korean test (TOPIK) for major placement, major courses or graduation; Korean Track units need TOPIK level 4 and level 5 to graduate.
